name: fdm_felix_food_switch_common
change_filament_gcode:
; FELIX Food Switch - Tool change G-code - V1.00
{if previous_extruder>=0}; Tool [previous_extruder] deactivation
G92 E0
G1 E-{retract_length_toolchange[previous_extruder]} F{retraction_speed[previous_extruder]*60}
G92 E0
{endif}T[next_extruder]
; Tool [next_extruder] activation
G92 E0
G1 E{retract_length_toolchange[next_extruder]+retract_restart_extra_toolchange[next_extruder]} F{retraction_speed[next_extruder]*60}
G92 E0
machine_end_gcode:
; FELIX Food Switch - OrcaSlicer End G-code - V1.00
G92 E0
G1 E-{retraction_length[0]} F{retraction_speed[0]*60} S0
G92 E0
G91
G1 Z10 F1200
G90
G28 X
G28 Y
M107
M84
